description.p: RimStack manages the mods of a RimWorld install. It starts in a fraction of a second with thousands of mods, follows the game while it runs, and sorts by reading what is inside the mods rather than only the rules their authors wrote down.

ul.li: Shows the load order in categories, and every move Sort makes with its reason first.
Reads each mod's compiled DLLs and XML patches for the load order rules nobody declared.
Follows Steam downloads, hand-made changes, new saves and the game's log by itself.
Writes nothing to the game before Save, and keeps the lists it replaces.

screenshot.caption: The load order in categories, with Sort ready to move six mods
